item.text: {"asks":[{"quote":"If you disagree, say so and I'll add it under Appearance.","question":"Do you want a preference to control whether the activity strip appears?"},{"quote":"Do you want Strata to normalize these, for example always showing \"Explore: search for tests\" style labels, or should it show what the provider sent?","question":"Should Strata normalize subagent labels or show provider-supplied labels?"},{"quote":"Tell me which you'd rather see and I'll do that one.","question":"Should finished activity remain under the message or move into the Trace drawer?"},{"quote":"Is eight the right number, or would you rather it show everything and scroll?","question":"Should the strip show eight rows or all rows with scrolling?"},{"quote":"Is that enough, or do you want the error inline?","question":"Should subagent errors appear inline in the activity strip?"},{"quote":"I can add it back if it's useful to you.","question":"Do you want per-subagent token usage shown in the strip?"},{"quote":"Let me know if you'd rather I hold this until the link-opening change lands, since both touch the Conversation panel and there's a small merge risk in the message component.","question":"Should I hold this work until the link-opening change lands?"}]}
